survey_note: On-demand finite-radius LOLA screening; transition crossings bracketed, unobserved short events possible. Earth visibility is line of sight only. Not validated against NASA illumination atlas.

study.disc_model: analytic area above piecewise-linear angular skyline
study.component_validation: Pointing, disc integration and ridge benchmarks documented; this scenario is not an independent observation.
study.earth_texture_orientation: SPICE IAU_EARTH at approximate light-time-corrected epoch; static NASA Blue Marble cloud mosaic

reference_sensitivity.definition: Deterministic 8-bearing ring plus centre, not a probability distribution. Sun=half disc, Earth=center LOS.
reference_sensitivity.limits: Native DEM accuracy unchanged. Hourly samples can miss short events. Moon-centre aberration shortcut is used for bulk sensitivity, separately bounded in validation.
